chunks: They said: "Burn him, and save your gods, if you are men of action."
ai.seo_question: What did the people say to save their gods when they decided to burn Prophet Ibrahim?
ai.summary: In the Shia exegetical tradition, this verse captures the decisive command of Ibrahim's people to execute him by fire, viewing it as a direct consequence of their entrenched polytheism (Tawassul to idols). It underscores the theological principle that false deities possess no power to save or punish, highlighting the contrast between human agency in the burning and divine protection in the aftermath.
